categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and property rights) in various villages, making it primarily concerned with land and property-related administrative matters. The content falls under the Land Gazette classification as it involves land registrations, title determinations, and property ownership details without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
